analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: a date bump (line 3) and one `stop` row in the request-parameter table (around line 2122). Base/head hunks are in other units; the supplied units 26/27 are head text of unchanged surrounding documentation (lines 3591-4070) covering cluster link probes, share probes, batch-invariant projections, served-speed records, Qwen MoE tensor parallel, GLM placement and prefill bounds. No executable code, keys, authorization, encryption or data-exposure behavior is changed in the supplied evidence. The stop-row edit describes per-request reasoning/tool-call exclusion for stop-string matching (ReasoningStopScope) and the native block engine matching whole output. It is documentation of source changes outside this batch, so I could not verify it against the code. If the implementation is part of this PR, a later pass should check that stop-sequence scoping cannot leak reasoning or tool-call content, and that the reported sequence replays the same scope. This is related to A-001 output handling and does not touch the prefix-cache threat T-041. Within the supplied text I saw no regression, invalidated threat-model assumption, or need to update the threat model. Cluster/TP content is unchanged context. Remaining question: whether the code behind the stop-scope documentation (EngineV2Bridge+StopSequence.swift, ReasoningStopScope) is in the PR and was reviewed elsewhere.
